notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kin-Tree Warden.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Sporemound ttriggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
